Stage.LogText: {=sp_hg_s0_log}You suspected the assassination mission and started an investigation. You are waiting for reports from your scouts to locate the looter parties carrying out provocations in your name... (1 Day)

{=sp_hg_s1_log}You suspected the assassination mission and started investigating. You must find and defeat 3 different looter parties wandering around using the name {PlayerName}. The truth will be revealed when you interrogate their scouts.
{=sp_hg_s2_log}You are interrogating the captured looters in isolation... Wait for them to break and reveal the location of their ringleader. (1 Day)
{=sp_hg_s3_log}It is time to interrogate the operatives. You must go to the nearby field operative party and speak with them.
{=sp_hg_s4_log}The captives told you the whereabouts of their ringleader. If you wait a bit, the real pigeons will come to you.
{=sp_hg_s5_log}You found out who the real traitor is. Now all you have to do is pledge your allegiance to the kingdom.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_hg_dlg1}We were sent by a looter in the field. Release our friends, and we will bring the looter to speak the truth.
{=sp_hg_dlg2}Tell me what you know, or I will put you all to the sword!
{=sp_hg_dlg3}We are just field operatives. The artisan tells us who to target. But the real boss will be here soon. Let us bring him to you!
{=sp_hg_dlg4}Alright, I'm letting you go. You're of no other use anyway. I'll be waiting for your ringleader.
{=sp_hg_dlg5}Halt! We are not here to draw swords... You released my soldiers. I am a looter field coordinator. What is the meaning of this? Are you trying to tell us something?
{=sp_hg_dlg6}Yes, I stand before you to prove I didn't kill the man we call our friend. I need to find out who started these slanderous rumors.
{=sp_hg_dlg7}No, I have no more business with you looters. I wasn't going to execute someone I don't even know for you.

{=sp_hg_dlg8}Kill? Then you are not the traitor among us... The real traitor is that rabid dog {ArtisanTarget_Link} who gave you the order. Your true mission should have been to return to the Motherland and offer your services.
{=sp_hg_dlg_p2_inq}So the assassination was never an official order from the realm? I was merely a pawn in his power struggle?
{=sp_hg_dlg_p2_prag}I knew something smelled foul. The artisan will pay for trying to deceive me.
{=sp_hg_dlg9}You passed an unexpected test, pigeon. You've more than proven your reliability. Farewell.
